notes:
Passed on the fake backend by python3 -m mhs.driver check (evidence contract_checked, never an MHS-Device level). Model-authored and unreviewed: the loader refuses the R2 hardware backend until reviewed_by is set. DEVIATION FROM THE CARD: the card's helper is PythonObjectDriver; this package uses a decorated direct Driver over zeus:ZeusModule (the card's decision is direct-driver) because the driver needs a native factory, typed action inputs and a safe-state action. Covered: the z_position read from the native pos attribute and the actions initialize, move_z, pick_tip, discard_tip, aspirate, dispense and emergency_stop. The upstream reply getters (getAbsoluteZPosition, getTipPresenceStatus, getInstrumentStatus, getFirmwareVersion, getErrorCode and the other get* methods) send a command and return None; the replies are assembled by the Notifier listener, so the driver does not expose firmware, status, error or tip-presence values. NOT COVERED: CAN frame assembly, kick/remote frames, error-string parsing, real replies and the hardware path; the fake records command effects in memory only and is not a recording or a transcript. The hardware path was never run. The clone is Python 2-era in places: sendDataObject calls data.encode('hex') (zeus.py:468) and constructs can.Message(extended_id=False, ...) (zeus.py:469-472), which modern Python 3/python-can no longer accept; the clone's setup.py and requirements.txt are empty, so pip install . alone installs nothing, and the operator must provide python-can and a configured can0. The off branch of setEmergencyStop references the undefined name seld (zeus.py:686), so the driver only sends the on command AB. Volumes are native counts and the clone states no unit; every numeric input is operator_required, and site-limits.example.json supplies example ranges only, not facts about a unit. The GA/GD optional fields qpm, lld, lldSearchPosition, liquidSurface, searchBottomMode and the mix fields are left at the upstream method defaults. The upstream LICENSE file is empty and the card records NOASSERTION/unknown, so no licence text of the clone grants rights. gate.digest is the digest the check printed (report without its clock); check-report.json is regenerated by every gate run and is not part of the package.
